prior_turn: progress: production qualification audited; export mechanism evidence located
hypothesis: Export intensity relative to domestic installation measures an external-demand dimension omitted by domestic installation growth; after price/market and installation controls it may improve return forecasts. Export shipments are not overseas final use; seasonal/shipping effects are alternatives.
source: Exact81 frozen R60 sources with R275 corrected article bodies
selection: Explicit 动力电池出口 amount, in current-month sentence or immediate 其中 sentence following current-month mixed total. Reject cumulative, 企业电池 and total mixed export; keep all rejected text.
feature: export_log_ratio=log(direct power export GWh/domestic installation GWh), same economic month and availability max. This is relative shipment scale, not market share or inventory. Zero/unknown excluded. Export YoY coverage diagnostic only, no alternate feature search.
model: R140 corrected battery cohort; FS market-controlled R64 FSM, FSB=FSMB, FSX=FSM+export_log_ratio, FSBX=FSMB+export_log_ratio; primary FSBX minus FSB, secondary FSX minus FS; all base/state/interaction via fixed R195. No claim all model families refit here.
fit: Same R198 annual Jan1 expanding strictly mature training,24 months minimum,Ridge alpha10,training-only StandardScaler; same sample for all methods,20day primary60day secondary; save skipped folds and original coverage
metrics: Paired date MSE and MAE, year and state; stability requires24 OOS dates and3 calendar years, plus future evidence. No action/cost assertion.
classification: No original R198 classification folds eligible; filtered subset cannot increase support; verify subset and ledger before reporting
scope: Historical-proxy, no collection, no deployment, no source-definition certification
parser_amendment: Observed monthly total and power component sometimes separated by exact sentence 合计出口占当月销量<number>%. Permit only this single bridge; keep attempt1. This corrects context linkage, not model gate.
